title: On the Block-Diagonalization and Multiplicative Equivalence of Quaternion $Z$-Block Circulant Matrices with their Applications
summary: The motivation of this paper is twofold. First, we investigate the block-diagonalization of the $z$-block circulant matrix $\mathtt{bcirc_z}(\mathcal A)$, based on this block-diagonal structure, and develop the algorithm $\mathtt{bcirc_z}$-inv for computing the inverse of $\mathtt{bcirc_z}(\mathcal A)$. Second, we establish the equivalence between the QT-product of tensors and the product of the corresponding $z$-block circulant matrices.
